title: Mechanical clocks in Europe
summary: The verge escapement made Europe's first mechanical clocks possible around 1300. Chinese water-driven clocks had used escapements since 723.
why: The escapement marked the beginning of the true mechanical clock in Europe.

notes.problem: Why overclaims: same source describes Chinese water-driven clockwork escapements from 723 and Su Song's 1088 clock tower; it says the escapement 'marks the beginning of the true mechanical clock'.
Same source credits Yi Xing (723) with the world's first clockwork escapement; 'weight-driven' not in source.

superlativeSource: which made possible the first mechanical clocks around 1300 in Europe
